messages:
luis_needham: Hey team — NeedhamBank here. We want to run a short POC for Redwood hosted inference. Main blockers: domain proofing for multi-domain tenant (need to claim bank.com + regional subdomains), SSO via SAML (Okta), SCIM for group/role sync, and RBAC mapping. Also need a ballpark for Dedicated vs hosted pricing for ~3M tokens/month and about 6k users. Can someone run through POC steps and highlight any enterprise security items?
jamie_re: @luis_needham yep — thanks for the summary. I can own coordination. Quick Q: how many distinct email domains do you need to claim?
luis_needham: Two main domains (bank.com and bank-eu.com) plus a handful of vendor subdomains we may onboard later (3).
arya_se: Hi @luis_needham — I'll handle the technical presales side. Short plan: 1) SAML test with a test IdP (provide metadata or redirect URL) 2) SCIM: verify attribute mapping for groups -> roles (we support both full and delta sync) 3) Domain proof: TXT or MX proof, we support delegated domain ownership if you want to keep DNS management. 4) RBAC: recommend canonical groups via SCIM and a small role whitelist in Redwood.
arya_se: For SCIM mapping example — send as a quick snippet: 
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "luis@bank.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Luis","familyName":"Gonzalez"},
  "meta": {"resourceType":"User"},
  "groups": [{"value":"sre-team","display":"SRE"}]
}
```
arya_se: Note we enforce SCIM rate limits on hosted tenants (200 reqs/min) — delta syncs are cheaper and preferred for large userbases.
neil_prod: From the runtime side: if you opt Dedicated we can reserve capacity to keep your 99th pct latency under 200ms for typical gen calls, and that affects pricing. Hosted will be simpler for the POC.
jamie_re: Pricing quick notes: Hosted: usage-based (per-token + embedding units). For 3M tokens/mo we'll give an enterprise slab that reduces per-token by ~20% after negotiation. Dedicated: baseline monthly commit + lower per-token/unit usage. I'll pull numbers into a one-pager after we confirm POC scope.
luis_needham: Also the security questionnaire — Do you have SOC2 + KMS options? We need audit logs for all generation calls and key separation between logs and model payloads.
security_ops: @luis_needham we are SOC2 Type II. For PII/PHI use-cases we recommend Private deployment (VPC/on-prem). We support customer-managed KMS and can send an audit-log export (S3 or syslog). What retention window do you need?
luis_needham: 13 months preferred, but 90 days for dev. Also need proof of encryption-in-transit and at-rest for logs.
security_ops: OK — can provide an evidence pack and KMS integration doc. For the POC we can enable 90-day retention export + access controls. For production we'll review the 13-month plan and pricing.
arya_se: For SAML specifics — please share IdP metadata xml or ACS URL. Sample assertion we expect: email, name, groups, and an optional custom claim "tenant_id" if you want automatic tenant routing. If you cannot expose groups in assertions we can map SCIM group -> role instead.
luis_needham: We'll share Okta metadata and a test account by EOD. Also curious about domain proof TTL — how long until domain verified?
arya_se: After you add a TXT record we usually pick it up within 5–10 minutes once DNS propagates, but plan for up to 24h for global DNS. If you want delegated proof (we publish a CNAME pointing to our verification service) it can speed onboarding but you lose direct control of the TXT.
jamie_re: Next steps: @arya_se to run SAML + SCIM dry run with Okta test metadata, @security_ops to send SOC2 + KMS docs, and I'll draft a pricing one-pager for Hosted vs Dedicated with approximate numbers. Can we schedule kickoff Wed 10am PT?
luis_needham: Wed 10am PT works. Thanks everyone. I added the Okta metadata in the shared folder and tagged this thread.
arya_se: Great — I'll send a checklist before the call (SAML metadata, SCIM base URL & token, DNS access, list of role->group mappings). Also pinging @neil_prod for any infra caveats during POC.
neil_prod: Noted — will be on the call. If you plan heavy SCIM full imports during the POC, please do them off-peak (we throttle to protect latency).
jamie_re: I'll follow up with calendar invite + pre-call checklist. :thumbsup:
